Dear Mr. Okonkwo,

We are pleased to confirm your reservation at the Seaview Inn for three nights, arriving Friday, August 15. Your room includes breakfast and free parking.

Check-in begins at 3 pm. If you expect to arrive after 10 pm, please let us know so we can arrange late check-in.

We look forward to welcoming you.

Warm regards,
The Seaview Inn
